title: NIST SP 800-61r3：決策證據新鮮度與重新評估觸發
titleEn: NIST SP 800-61r3: evidence freshness and decision reassessment triggers
subcategoryTitle: 事件演練、服務恢復與可驗證交接
subcategoryTitleEn: Incident exercises, service recovery and verifiable handoffs
summary: 為每個決策依據保存observed_at、適用範圍、來源與本地政策有效期；在固定決策時間判定新鮮、過期或未知，並保留歷史。
summaryEn: Record observed_at, scope, source and a locally defined lifetime for each decision input. At a fixed decision time, classify evidence as fresh, stale or unknown while preserving its history.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

stages.title: 建立證據觀測與有效期
stages.description: 事件指揮沿用半小時前的資產狀態，忽略新部署可能改變影響範圍；本課為決策依據建立有效期與重新驗證要求。 為每個決策依據保存observed_at、適用範圍、來源與本地政策有效期；在固定決策時間判定新鮮、過期或未知，並保留歷史。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 每項依據另列required_for_decision與supersedes_id；刷新必須新增觀測而不是改舊列。把必要第五項維持unknown，即使其餘四項全新鮮也要求決策保持待查，展示總比例不能取代逐項准入條件。
stages.descriptionEn: An incident commander reuses an old asset-state observation despite a deployment that may have changed the affected scope. The lesson assigns evidence freshness and explicit reassessment requirements to decision inputs. Record observed_at, scope, source and a locally defined lifetime for each decision input. At a fixed decision time, classify evidence as fresh, stale or unknown while preserving its history. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Add required_for_decision and supersedes_id to every evidence input. Refreshing creates a new observation rather than editing the old row. Keep the mandatory fifth input unknown and require the decision to remain pending even with four fresh inputs, showing why an aggregate fraction cannot replace per-input admission requirements.
